parsed.name: TEMPer USB温度传感器
parsed.description: 一种通过 USB 连接的温度传感器设备，用于实验中采集环境温度或样品附近温度。根据型号不同，可支持 1 到 2 个传感器通道，部分型号还可读取湿度数据，并可应用校准比例与偏移。
parsed.description_en: A USB-connected temperature sensing device used in laboratory setups to measure ambient temperature or temperature near a sample. Depending on the model, it may support 1 to 2 sensor channels, and some variants can also report humidity and apply calibration scale and offset.

actions.description: 根据配置设置校准比例和偏移。
actions.description_en: Set calibration scale and offset from configuration.

actions.description: 查找指定传感器的温度偏移量。
actions.description_en: Look up the temperature offset for a specified sensor.

actions.description: 查找指定传感器的湿度偏移量。
actions.description_en: Look up the humidity offset for a specified sensor.

actions.description: 根据产品名称查找设备的传感器数量。
actions.description_en: Look up the number of sensors on the device based on the product name.

actions.description: 关闭设备连接；此设备通常无需额外清理。
actions.description_en: Close the device connection; this device typically requires no additional cleanup.
